licenseName: Natural Earth public domain; derived metadata in Mundus
version: world-atlas 2.0.2 / slot schema 7 (parallel default, rotated narrow countries)
attribution: Candidate wordmark slots derived from the pinned Natural Earth country geometry; parallel-latitude envelopes by default, axis-aligned straight envelopes for elongated countries, adjacent-land rejection, and bounded isolated-island overflow are applied before display.
transformations: Rank every interior center of a fixed 5x5 grid by a dense long-envelope fit and hill-climb the best center toward the widest clear area
Offer straight rotated envelopes within 35 degrees of the principal axis only for countries with interior elongation >= 2, keeping them when at least 1.15x the best horizontal fit
Precompute strict own-country envelopes, foreign-land clearance, country-scale caps, and bounded isolated-island overflow from the pinned atlas
Round derived numbers to nine significant digits so rebuilds are byte-stable across runtimes
Store only compact candidate metadata; do not include raw country geometry
missingValuePolicy: Countries without a safe candidate remain visible in the surname side panel but have no map wordmark.
boundaryPolicy: Ordinary candidates remain inside their own country. Isolated-country candidates may extend into ocean within an area-scaled cap, but are rejected when their aspect-specific spherical glyph envelope approaches another country's land geometry.
